title: Host adapter binding configuration schema
description: Validation schema for adapters/<env>/tools.yaml: the host-specific tool/payload binding an adapter reads. INTERNAL configuration — adapter-owned (ships with the adapter, resolved structurally), unlike the conf/*.conf.yaml files which are the embedding framework's EXTERNAL configuration. Both families go through the same one-act loader (parse + contract-validate); only ownership and location differ. hostSessionKeys/hostParentSessionKeys extract host-observed sessionId/parentSessionId values for adapter-mediated sessions; other invocation surfaces may mint or source session ids outside this adapter binding.

additionalProperties.description: The harness action verb this host tool performs.

deleteTools.description: Host tool names that delete files (mapped to the delete action — denied unconditionally in v1, core function 8).

toolKeys.description: Ordered payload field names to probe for the host tool name.

inputKeys.description: Ordered payload field names to probe for the tool's input argument.

pathKeys.description: Ordered payload field names to probe for the target artifact path.

nestedPathKeys.description: Path expressions extracting artifact paths nested in array payloads, where no flat key reaches them (e.g. replacements[].filePath) — each yields zero or more paths per call.

items.description: One dotted path expression; [] marks an array to fan out over.

hostSessionKeys.description: Ordered payload field names to probe for the host-observed session id.

hostParentSessionKeys.description: Ordered payload field names to probe for the host-observed parent session id.

hostStepSessionKeys.description: Ordered payload field names to probe for the host-observed step-session id (the per-dispatch invocation id).

hostStepActorKeys.description: Ordered payload field names to probe for the step session's acting agent identity.

dispatchTools.description: Host tool names that start a child step-session (subagent dispatch).

dispatchAgentKeys.description: Ordered payload field names to probe for the dispatched agent identity.

dispatchModelKeys.description: Ordered payload field names to probe for the model profile identifier.

mediatedCommandTools.description: Host tool names carrying agent-authored command strings that may invoke the harness command entry point (the mediated attribution surface — functions 3–4 only).

mediatedCommandKeys.description: Ordered payload field names to probe for the command string of a mediated-command tool.

guardedShellTools.description: Host tool names whose command strings can reach the filesystem outside any write-classified tool (terminals, task runners). A command that textually references a workspace artifact-layout path or the workspace logs path is DENIED at the pre-tool boundary — an advisory-grade guard (textual matching is bypassable; C6's detect-and-remediate plane remains the guarantee), closing the routine write escape hatch.

keyList.description: Ordered payload field names to probe (first hit wins). Empty means the host offers no such field.
